market_view: Calm regime: VIX 14.9, down 7% over 5 days and 52% below its 1-year high; the 10-year eased to 4.66% and the dollar is soft, helping metals. Crude rebounded on Hormuz deal doubts after a sharp weekly drop.

oil_gas.reasoning: 'Oil prices climb as Iranian demands cloud outlook for Strait of Hormuz' (Al Jazeera) is a stalemate, not a renewed closure; the bounce is already in crude. Trump pressure on XOM/CVX profits is still a downside risk. No one-sided setup.

gold_miners.catalyst: 'Barrick Mining Settles Newmont Nevada Dispute for $1.95 Billion' (WSJ) and 'Barrick and Newmont gold mining truce clears way for IPO' (FT): a cash payment to NEM and removal of JV uncertainty, published after the 08-07 close used in the record.
gold_miners.reasoning: NEM-specific value event (about 1.5% of market cap) plus clarity on Nevada assets; gold support from lower yields and a softer dollar. Tempered by NEM already +20.6% in 5 days and gold 17% below its high; some premarket pricing likely.

chips.catalyst: none strong enough: 'TSMC's sales surge 45% amid buoyant AI demand' (CNBC) confirms an expected AI trend
chips.reasoning: NVDA +11.6% in 5 days and 5% from its high, so strong AI demand looks priced. NVDA earnings in late August add two-sided variance. The position limit is better spent on the two held longs plus NEM.

pharma.catalyst: Held since 2026-08-05: Lilly Q2 results with a full-year guidance raise after an 8.6% pre-earnings drop (previous note).
pharma.reasoning: LLY rose 3.2% over 5 days, so the print was received well and no sell-off occurred; no drug-pricing headline in the record. Keep until the hold ends around 2026-08-19.

copper_uranium.catalyst: 'EXCLUSIVE: Congo bans copper and cobalt concentrates exports, official order says' (Reuters): a new supply shock to copper on top of the existing squeeze, published after the 08-07 close.
copper_uranium.reasoning: Congo is a major copper supplier; a concentrate export ban tightens the market for non-Congo producers like FCX. Copper 2% off its 1-year high; FCX +11% in 5 days. Keep the 20-day hold (ends around 2026-08-28).

would_change_my_mind: Congo reversing or carving out the export ban, a sharp dollar rebound, LLY selling off on drug-pricing news, or details showing the Barrick-Newmont settlement is not net positive for NEM.

handoff.what_changed: Reuters: Congo banned copper and cobalt concentrate exports, a new supply shock supporting the FCX long. Barrick settled the Nevada JV dispute with Newmont for $1.95B, clearing the way for an IPO; opened a NEM long. Crude rebounded (WTI 78, headlines cite above 82) on Hormuz deal doubts; LLY +3.2% over 5 days after its guidance raise.

oil_gas.why: Hormuz stalemate rebound is already priced and Trump pressure on oil majors persists; no one-sided catalyst.

gold_miners.why: Barrick pays Newmont $1.95B to settle the Nevada JV dispute, clearing uncertainty; gold helped by lower yields.

chips.why: TSMC sales +45% confirms AI demand but NVDA +11.6% in 5 days already prices it; earnings late August are two-sided.

pharma.why: Q2 guidance raise received well (+3.2% in 5 days); no pricing threat seen.

copper_uranium.why: Congo concentrate export ban adds to the copper supply squeeze; copper 2% off its 1-year high.

open_storylines.note: Stalemate: Iranian demands cloud a Hormuz deal; WTI 78 (headlines cite above 82). Re-enter XOM only on renewed closure or tanker attacks with crude not yet repriced.

open_storylines.note: No new action seen; watch for a windfall tax, export limits or SPR releases (negative for XOM).

open_storylines.name: Gold bear market and rising yields
open_storylines.note: Gold 4400, +7% in 5 days but 17% below its high; 10-year 4.66% near its 1-year high. A yield rebound would hurt NEM.

open_storylines.name: Barrick-Newmont Nevada settlement and IPO
open_storylines.note: $1.95B settlement and IPO of Barrick's North American spinoff; NEM long. Watch deal details, payment timing and NEM's reaction; exit if it is judged negative for NEM.

open_storylines.note: SOXX +7.8% in 5 days; TSMC sales +45%; Nvidia $500B financing push with Apollo, BlackRock, KKR. Watch NVDA earnings late August and export rules.

open_storylines.note: No update; watch metals and energy carve-outs and retaliation.

open_storylines.note: LLY long; stock +3.2% over 5 days. Exit on a sell-off or drug-pricing news; hold ends around 2026-08-19.
